verdict.rationale: The Profile API is a documented, first-party way for an agent to query customer data programmatically: the full user or account object, including external_ids, traits, and events. The Public API is a documented CRUD API with an OpenAPI spec and token auth, but its listed resources are Sources, Destinations, Warehouses and Tracking Plans, not Audiences. Audience building and syncing are described only as product features, with no API or MCP path shown, so the create/activate half of the end-to-end story is unevidenced. Missing for 10: documented API or MCP endpoints to create Audiences, programmatic activation or sync of Audiences to destinations, any first-party MCP server, and hands-on corroboration of a dashboard-free agent workflow.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can query customer data and create or activate audiences end to end through documented APIs or MCP — no dashboard in the loop

citations.quote: The Segment Profile API provides a single API to read user-level and account-level customer data. You can query the entire user or account object programmatically
Use the Profile API to programmatically query user profiles, traits, and events.
You can use the API to perform CRUD (create, read, update, and delete) operations at no extra charge. This includes working with resources such as Sources, Destinations, Warehouses, Tracking Plans
The Segment Public API helps you manage your Segment Workspaces and its resources.
